messages:
jon_sales: Quick warm pass for Albatross — closed last week, $180k ARR, committed to Dedicated capacity (4 GPUs) with possible private deployment later. Needs SSO (Okta), data ingestion pipeline for docs, and an enablement session for their ML infra team. Renewal in 11 months, but privacy/regulatory review flagged as potential risk. cc: @maria_csm and @sam_se for handoff.

maria_csm: Thanks — picking this up. Can you drop the deal doc + current SSO notes? Also who is the primary technical contact on their side?

jon_sales: Sent the contract + solution brief in email (link: https://redwood.internal/deals/albatross). Primary is Elena V. (Director of AI Ops). Secondary is Dev lead: Marco R. They requested a kickoff next Tue.

sam_se: Looping in; I'll do technical kickoff. Quick heads-up: they want on-prem ingestion (SFTP -> object store) and want to evaluate lower-prec models for latency-sensitive endpoints. Need to validate our Dedicated network egress policy for their SOC.

lee_eng: @sam_se do we have a standard checklist for Private vs Dedicated networking requirements? I can prep the infra notes and any limitations (SLA, HSM/KMS).

sam_se: Yep — I'll paste the checklist in this thread.

sam_se: ```
Pre-kickoff tech checklist:
- Confirm Okta SAML metadata + test user
- Network: IP allowlist + VPN config or Private VPC peering
- Storage: SFTP -> object store path + retention policy
- Dedicated capacity sizing: 4x A100 equiv (confirm seq len profile)
- Model variants: opt for 8-bit quantized baseline for latency tests
- Audit: KMS/HSM + syslog endpoints
```

maria_csm: Thanks. Immediate CS priorities: 1) Schedule 60m kickoff (enablement + tech) 2) Provision trial Dedicated pool in staging 3) Capture any compliance docs for renewals 4) Create success plan and training schedule. I'll assign owners below.

maria_csm: Owners: Kickoff scheduling - @jon_sales (confirm availability), Tech setup & staging - @sam_se, Provisioning ticket & KMS - @lee_eng, Support SLA questions - @ash_support, Success plan + onboarding tasks - me (maria_csm).

ash_support: Noted. I'll open a triage ticket to track staging provisioning + add SSO and log shipping as sub-tasks. Ticket template: "Customer: Albatross — staging provisioning for Dedicated".

ops_bot: Created ticket CS-8472: "Albatross — staging provisioning for Dedicated" and assigned to ash_support. Estimated SLA: 3 business days.

jon_sales: I scheduled the kickoff for Tue 10am PST with Elena + Marco. Calendar invite sent.

maria_csm: Great. For renewal risk: their legal/compliance team flagged data residency concerns that could push them to evaluate on-prem earlier than expected. Action: capture compliance checklist during kickoff, escalate to enterprise sales if it looks like private deploy is required.

sam_se: During kickoff I'll run two mini tests: 1) sample latency test with quantized small model 2) a dry-run of doc ingestion pipeline to validate mapping. Need credentials or sample data — can we get sanitized sample from Elena?

jon_sales: Elena agreed to provide a 2GB sanitized corpus by Mon EOD.

lee_eng: I'll start preparing the KMS/HSM integration doc and a short runbook for prov-onboarding. Will post link here before kickoff.

maria_csm: Capture feedback loop: We'll send a 5-min survey after the enablement call and maintain a prompt set to monitor generation quality. If quality regressions appear, engage research/ops. Owner: maria_csm.

ash_support: Added sub-tasks to CS-8472: SSO test account, IP allowlist, sample ingestion, log forwarding. ETA: 72 hours.

sam_se: FYI — Marco asked about RBAC for model routing (can we pin endpoints per team?). Short answer: yes, via per-route API keys + Console roles. I'll include a quick how-to in the kickoff.

maria_csm: Next steps summary (owners):
- Jon: Confirm any outstanding contract questions + calendar invite (done)
- Sam: Tech kickoff + run tests (owner)
- Lee: Provisioning/KMS notes + staging config (owner)
- Ash: Open ticket & manage provisioning tasks (owner)
- Maria: Success plan, survey, renewal-risk tracking (owner)
Please react :white_check_mark: when you accept.

jon_sales: ✅

sam_se: ✅

lee_eng: ✅ I'll post the KMS doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-albatross before kickoff.

ash_support: ✅ Ticket CS-8472 updated with sub-tasks.

maria_csm: Thanks team. If we identify that private deploy is necessary after kickoff, let's flag for a quick architecture sync with Product (cc @lee_eng will loop in product).

jon_sales: One more note — Elena mentioned budget runway depends on a successful POC within 45 days. Marking as tight-timebox.

maria_csm: Noted. I'll add 45-day POC milestone to success plan and create weekly check-ins. Closing this thread for now; will reopen with kickoff notes and next action updates.

ops_bot: Thread archived to channel 'customer-success' per user request.
